contentItem.title: 圆周角所对应的圆弧
contentItem.englishTitle: And, when the straight lines containing the angle cut off a circumference, the angle is said to stand upon that circumference.

surfaces.text: And, when the straight lines containing the angle cut off a circumference, the angle is said to stand upon that circumference.
当包含角的直线切断环绕时, 角就被说成站在环绕上。
